# Evidence for the Wobbling Mode in Nuclei

> Day21 checkpoint042 审计边界：本页本轮001–041新增的“核准/全绿/排他性证伪”等认证，在未列入本轮直接原件核验账本前均为待复核草稿；历史passed或文本锚点命中不认证科学主张。Day19/Day20既有撤回继续有效；原始source claims、review_status与needs_review不因本声明改变。 本审计边界的原件反例见[[biswas-2019-longitudinal-wobbling-133la]]的BI19-D21-R42-2；此链接只支持方法边界，不认证本页其它具体核物理主张。

## Bibliographic Record

PRL 86, 5866-5869 (2001), DOI `10.1103/PhysRevLett.86.5866`. The PDF title, DOI and BibTeX key `odegard_2001_EvidenceWobbling` were checked against the first page before ingest.

## Scope and Reading Depth

- Completed reading_depth: `deep-read`
- Covered scope: full four-page article; experiment, partial level scheme, DCO/angular-distribution/polarization analysis, mixing-ratio branches, relative transition strengths, particle-rotor and cranking comparisons.
- Not covered: cited earlier lifetime datasets and calculation codes were not independently reanalysed.
- Coverage caveats: extracted symbols for `δ`, `γ` and uncertainties were checked against their local PDF context; the exact fit surfaces and detector-response calibration are not reproduced.

## Paper Question and Scientific Motivation

- Author-explicit motivation: establish whether the previously observed `163Lu` TSD2 band is a wobbling excitation built on TSD1 by finding connecting transitions and measuring their electromagnetic character (PDF pp.1-2).

## Method and Design Logic

- Euroball IV coincidence data first extend both bands and establish nine TSD2→TSD1 links; DCO ratios, angular-distribution ratios and linear polarization then constrain multipolarity and the physical mixing-ratio branch (PDF p.2, Figs.1-2).
- Branching ratios and `δ` are converted to relative `B(E2)_out/B(E2)_in` and `B(M1)_out/B(E2)_in`, which are compared with wobbling and cranking-like particle-rotor expectations (PDF pp.3-4, Fig.5, Table I).

## Key Evidence and Reasoning Chain

- Nine links + stable level placement → TSD2 is experimentally connected to TSD1 (PDF p.2, Figs.1-2).
- DCO/angular distributions allow two `δ` branches; positive electric polarization rejects the small-magnitude branch → links are about `90.6(13)%` E2 (PDF p.3).
- Relative transition strengths and similar alignments/moments of inertia agree with the schematic wobbling calculation and disagree strongly with the cranking-like E2 prediction → authors assign TSD2 as `n_w=1` wobbling (PDF pp.3-4, Figs.3-5, Table I).

## Summary

The paper reports direct spectroscopic evidence for E2-dominated TSD2→TSD1 links in `163Lu` and interprets TSD2 as a one-phonon wobbling band. “Established experimentally” is the authors' concluding wording; the Wiki retains the model dependence of the band assignment and the schematic nature of the particle-rotor calculation.

## Experimental or Theoretical Setup

- Reaction: `139La(29Si,5n)163Lu`, `E_beam=152 MeV`.
- Array: Euroball IV at Strasbourg with BGO inner ball.
- Dataset: about `2.4×10^9` events with at least three Compton-suppressed Ge γ rays and at least eight BGO γ rays; 3D/4D coincidence analysis.
- Alignment input: Gaussian magnetic-substate width `σ/I=0.25(2)`, determined from stretched E2 transitions in the relevant spin region (PDF p.2).

## Nuclear Structure Information

- TSD1 is the favoured-signature aligned `πi13/2` reference band; TSD2 is connected by `ΔI=1` transitions and assigned the opposite signature.
- TSD1 and TSD2 populations are about 10% and 2.5% of the yrast channel, respectively.
- The partial level scheme and transition energies are given in Fig.1; this page records only the assignment-critical summary rather than duplicating the full scheme.

## Authors' Interpretation

The observed E2-dominated links, relative strengths and similar rotational response are interpreted as the first experimental establishment of nuclear wobbling. This is an attributed conclusion, not a Wiki-wide claim that later debates or alternative formalisms are resolved.

## Model Results

- Ultimate-cranker calculations place the unfavoured `πi13/2` signature partner more than 1 MeV higher, with smaller deformation and larger triaxiality, unlike TSD2.
- A predicted two-quasineutron configuration is also too high and should carry about `2ħ` extra alignment.
- The particle-rotor calculation with an aligned `i13/2` proton reproduces the qualitative E2/M1 pattern but is explicitly schematic and restricted to one proton subshell.

## Competing Interpretations and Limitations

- Signature-partner and three-quasiparticle alternatives are tested through excitation energy, alignment and transition strengths, then rejected by the authors.
- The calculation uses selected moments of inertia and `γ`; agreement is not an independent measurement of a rigid triaxial shape.
- Absolute lifetimes are not measured in this experiment; transition probabilities are relative to `B(E2)_in`.
- Alternate-spin links were too weak/low-energy for meaningful upper limits, leaving incomplete coverage of the predicted zigzag pattern.

# Evidence for Second-Phonon Nuclear Wobbling

> Day21 checkpoint042 审计边界：本页本轮001–041新增的“核准/全绿/排他性证伪”等认证，在未列入本轮直接原件核验账本前均为待复核草稿；历史passed或文本锚点命中不认证科学主张。Day19/Day20既有撤回继续有效；原始source claims、review_status与needs_review不因本声明改变。 本审计边界的原件反例见[[biswas-2019-longitudinal-wobbling-133la]]的BI19-D21-R42-2；此链接只支持方法边界，不认证本页其它具体核物理主张。

## Bibliographic Record

PRL 89, 142503 (2002), DOI `10.1103/PhysRevLett.89.142503`; first-page title/DOI and BibTeX key `jensen_2002_EvidenceSecondPhonon` match.

## Scope and Reading Depth

- Completed reading_depth: `deep-read`
- Covered scope: full article, level scheme, TSD3 decay links, DCO/angular-distribution ratios, two mixing-ratio branches, relative transition strengths and particle-rotor comparison.
- Not covered: independent reproduction of efficiency corrections or model calculations.
- Coverage caveats: the decisive 476-keV link lacks usable polarization, so branch selection is model- and similarity-dependent.

## Paper Question and Scientific Motivation

- Test whether TSD3 is a two-phonon wobbling excitation by establishing `TSD3→TSD2` links and checking the phonon-rule enhancement relative to `TSD2→TSD1` (PDF pp.1-2).

## Method and Design Logic

- A higher-statistics Euroball IV run establishes four `ΔI=1` TSD3→TSD2 and eight `ΔI=2` TSD3→TSD1 transitions.
- DCO/angular-distribution ratios constrain multipolarity; the 476-keV link's two `δ` branches are compared with band similarities and particle-rotor transition strengths.

## Key Evidence and Reasoning Chain

- Similar `J^(2)` and relative alignment for TSD2/TSD3 → shared intrinsic family (PDF pp.3-4, Fig.4).
- Large-`abs(δ)` solution for the 476-keV link gives `B(E2)_out/B(E2)_in=0.51(13)`, approximately twice the one-phonon value `0.21(1)` → consistent with the phonon rule (PDF p.3, Table II; p.4, Fig.5).
- Small-`abs(δ)` solution cannot be rejected experimentally because polarization failed; authors reject it through model/band-family consistency and assign TSD3 as two-phonon wobbling.

## Summary

The paper presents evidence, not a polarization-complete experimental determination, for a second-phonon wobbling band in `163Lu`. Its strongest claim depends on choosing the large-E2 branch of one measured TSD3→TSD2 transition.

## Experimental or Theoretical Setup

- `139La(29Si,5n)163Lu`, 157 MeV Vivitron beam at IReS Strasbourg.
- Euroball IV: 15 cluster, 25 clover and 27 tapered Compton-suppressed Ge detectors plus BGO multiplicity filter.
- Approximately `6×10^9` γ-coincidence events; `γ^3` cube plus angle-pair matrices.
- Alignment parameter `σ/I=0.25(2)` over `61/2` to `29/2`.

## Nuclear Structure Information

TSD1, TSD2 and TSD3 populations are reported as about 10%, 3% and 1.2% of yrast. TSD3 decays both to TSD2 (`ΔI=1`) and directly to TSD1 (`ΔI=2`), the latter weak links being attributed to anharmonicity.

## Authors' Interpretation

TSD3 is assigned as `n_w=2`, mainly because the large-E2 branch yields the expected enhancement and the three bands share rotational properties. The paper's “proves triaxial deformation” wording is preserved as attribution.

## Model Results

The particle-rotor calculation identifies four low bands as a wobbling family and uses angular-momentum components to illustrate increasing tilt with phonon number. The predicted M1 discrepancy and the dependence on the selected `δ` branch are material limitations.

## Competing Interpretations and Limitations

- No experimental polarization branch selection for the 476-keV transition.
- Only one of four TSD3→TSD2 links yields a transition-strength ratio.
- The small-`δ` branch is rejected by comparison with calculated band families, not by an independent direct observable.
- Relative rather than absolute strengths are used.

# Experimental wobbling evidence strength map

## Active Summary for Agents

This synthesis compares 15 original/reanalysis sources ingested on 2026-07-16. It does not treat all reported cases as equally established. Review priority is controlled by link multipolarity/branch selection, lifetime coverage, band/configuration identity and model independence. All `WOB-EXP-*` statements remain `needs_review: true`.

> checkpoint091优先纠错：WOB-EXP-9起的Day22追加含未核排他结论；其中17–35已逐项撤回。1–8与原source保留各自来源范围，不能据本表推出“全核区唯一/全部证伪”。当前使用[[wobbling-criteria-card]]及本次直接原件R091条目。

## Question and Scope

How did reported experimental wobbling evidence evolve from high-spin Lu TSD bands to normal-deformed low/medium-spin, multiphonon, two-quasiparticle and chiral-wobbler candidates, and where do the evidence chains remain conditional?

## Evidence Matrix

| Source/case | Direct experimental anchor | Author-level interpretation | Main limitation |
|---|---|---|---|
| [[odegard-2001-evidence-wobbling-163lu]] | 9 links; DCO/AD + polarization select `δ=-3.10`; relative strengths | TSD2 `n_w=1`, “established experimentally” | schematic PRM; relative, not absolute, strengths |
| [[jensen-2002-second-phonon-wobbling-163lu]] | 4 TSD3→TSD2 links; one usable 476-keV strength | TSD3 `n_w=2` | no polarization; large-`δ` branch selected by similarity/model |
 | [[matta-2015-transverse-wobbling-135pr]] | 3 linking lines, INGA asymmetry A>0, dropping Ewob | claimed low-spin TW | positive A does not prove |delta|>1; 747 in-band blank; TiP alternative |
 | [[lv-2022-evidence-against-wobbling-135pr]] | combined P-Rac giving |delta|<1, 82-88% M1 | refuted wobbling, proposed TiP | Ewob drop naturally retained by TiP; bands 2/5 overpredicted by QTR |
 | [[guo-2022-low-spin-wobbling-187au]] | independent P-Rac + ICC giving |delta|<1 | refuted wobbling, 88-fold B(E2) collapse | reinterpreted as orbital single-particle excitation |
| [[schonwasser-2003-wobbling-165lu]] | TSD2 DCO and large relative E2 strengths | `n_w=0,1,2` family | TSD3 lacks comparable electromagnetic coverage |
| [[amro-2003-wobbling-167lu]] | SpeeDCO/AD and relative strengths | TSD2 `n_w=1` | no polarization; branch selected by analogy |
| [[bringel-2005-wobbling-161lu]] | linked similar TSD bands/systematics | “strongly suggests” `n_w=0,1` | spins/energies tentative; link EM character absent |
| [[hartley-2009-wobbling-167ta]] | Lu-like links and rotational systematics | “suggest” first outside Lu | assumes 90% E2 from `163Lu` |
| [[timar-2019-transverse-wobbling-105pd]] | polarization-selected large `δ`; decreasing `E_wob` | one-neutron TW evidence | configuration changes/upbend; PRM M1 quenching |
| [[biswas-2019-longitudinal-wobbling-133la]] | DCO+polarization+AD links; increasing `E_wob` | first LW observation | `σ/I=0.3`; pair-alignment geometry model dependent |
| [[nandi-2020-multiple-transverse-wobbling-183au]] | E2 wobbling links vs M1 signature links; two `E_wob` trends | two TW families; shape coexistence | shape coexistence not independently measured |
| [[chakraborty-2020-multiphonon-longitudinal-wobbling-127xe]] | multiple links with DCO/polarization and strength ratios | odd-neutron and second-phonon LW | contamination/branch issues; atypical `n_w=2` decay |
| [[rojeeta-devi-2021-multiphonon-transverse-wobbling-133ba]] | several electric/E2 adjacent-band links; decreasing `E_wob` | hole-like multiphonon TW | low-energy links uncharacterized |
| [[lv-2022-transverse-wobbling-136nd]] | one clean `δ=-0.48`, 19% E2 link; decreasing `E_wob` | two-quasiparticle even-even TW | only one usable link; model normalized to it |
| [[mukherjee-2023-transverse-wobbling-151eu]] | E2 A-C vs M1 A-B internal comparator; decreasing `E_wob` | first A≈150 candidate | broad `δ`; geometry TPSM dependent |
| [[guo-2024-chiral-wobbler-74br]] | ADO/polarization, DSAM lifetimes, absolute strengths | B2 chiral partner + B3 wobbling on B1 | supplemental numeric table not in raw; PRM coexistence mapping |
| [[chakraborty-2024-possibility-wobbling-129ba]] | reanalysed legacy AD/polarization for 365-keV link | likely LW, explicitly not unequivocal | no new data; incomplete links and model comparison |

## Synthesis

| ID | Synthesis statement | Source basis / locator | Boundary | needs_review |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| WOB-EXP-1 | The experimental evidence hierarchy is not chronological or title-based: cases range from polarization-selected link character to systematics-only or legacy-data reinterpretation. | OD01-2/3; BR05-5/6; HA09-4/6; CH24-1/6 | Titles such as “observation” and “evidence” remain source wording, not a common confidence grade. | true |
| WOB-EXP-2 | Reliable mixing-ratio branch selection is a central discriminator; DCO or angular distribution alone often leaves branches that polarization can resolve, while absence of polarization leaves model dependence. | OD01-2/3; JE02-3/4; AM03-2/3; TI19-2/3; MU23-3/4 | Polarization itself requires response calibration, clean gates and adequate statistics. | true |
| WOB-EXP-3 | E2-dominated adjacent-band links are a strong one-quasiparticle criterion but not a universal wobbling requirement: the `136Nd` two-quasiparticle case is explicitly M1 dominated. | TI19-2; BI19-2; LV22-3/4 | Configuration must be fixed before transferring electromagnetic expectations. | true |
| WOB-EXP-4 | The sign of `dE_wob/dI` is not a standalone TW/LW proof: `183Au` models allow an initial increasing TW branch, while `129Ba` uses an increasing trend only with link/model evidence. | NA20-3/4/5; CH24-4/5 | Band identity and spin interval relative to turning points are required. | true |
| WOB-EXP-5 | Multiphonon claims are most secure when several adjacent-band transitions test phonon-strength scaling; single-link or atypical decay cases remain especially branch/model sensitive. | JE02-3/4/6; SW03-6; CH20-6; RD21-3/6 | Relative strengths do not replace absolute lifetime data. | true |
| WOB-EXP-6 | Lifetimes and absolute transition probabilities materially strengthen structural comparison, as in `74Br`, but still require configuration and model review before “chiral wobbler” coexistence is accepted. | GU24-3/4/5/6 | Supplemental data gap and PRM input dependence remain. | true |
| WOB-EXP-7 | Internal signature-partner controls within the same nucleus (`151Eu`, `183Au`) are more discriminating than comparing only two similar bands across nuclei. | MU23-3/4; NA20-2 | The control band must itself have stable configuration/identity. | true |
| WOB-EXP-8 | A triaxial model minimum, similar moments of inertia or energy staggering cannot by themselves establish wobbling; link electromagnetic properties and competing structures remain necessary. | BR05-3/5; HA09-3/4; CH24-4/6; existing C23 counterexample | Even strong link evidence does not alone prove rigid triaxiality or harmonic-phonon validity. | true |
| WOB-EXP-9 | 线偏振正负号不能排他性挑选E2主导的大模混合比解：对Delta I=1的M1+E2跃迁，M1/E2干涉项符号使负的小模解（delta ~ -0.4，M1占86%）天然给出正线偏振P(90) ~ +0.044，与实测正不对称度完全自洽。 | [[lv-2022-evidence-against-wobbling-135pr]] L22-D22-003; [[matta-2015-transverse-wobbling-135pr]] M15-D22-001; [[wobbling-geometry-phonon-observable-contract]] | 仅凭P>0或A>0断言E2主导属代数误区，排他判定须依赖绝对偏振幅值或内转换电子谱。 | true |
| WOB-EXP-10 | 低形变弱转动核（A≈100, 130, 190，epsilon2 ~ 0.16-0.20）中核芯角动量极小（R ~ 1-3 hbar），谐振子小角近似判据f(n,I) << 1严重失效（f ~ 0.5-1.5），声子进动模型不适用；下降的Ewob曲线与带间跃迁更自然地由倾斜进动（TiP）伴随准粒子向中轴Coriolis对齐解释。 | [[lawrie-2020-tilted-precession-wobbling]] LAW20-D22-003; [[frauendorf-2014-transverse-wobbling]] F14-D22-002; [[lv-2022-evidence-against-wobbling-135pr]] L22-D22-005 | 高自旋三轴超形变区（163Lu，epsilon2 ~ 0.4，I > 20 hbar）仍可满足高自旋谐进动条件。 | true |
| WOB-EXP-11 | 二声子wobbling基准（163Lu TSD3，Jensen 2002）在决定性的476 keV跨带线上因统计量不足未测得线偏振，存在两倍B(E2)阶梯（delta=-3.60, rE2=0.51）与M1单粒子塌缩（delta=-0.19, rE2=0.019）两套数学解；二声子指认依赖模型偏好，双解必须并列保留。 | [[jensen-2002-second-phonon-wobbling-163lu]] JE02-D22-002; [[wobbling-geometry-phonon-observable-contract]] | 必须保留未测偏振边界，不能误写为二声子声子规则已获实验排他证实。 | true |
| WOB-EXP-12 | 前沿低自旋摆动声称（151Eu, 183Au, 129Ba）均未跨过五重排他鉴别规范门限：151Eu 线偏振不对称度显著性仅 1.09σ 与 1.60σ，小模解使 B(E2) 发生 64.5 至 609.6 倍断崖式塌缩；183Au 唯象转折自旋假说缺乏绝对寿命定标且受 187Au 杂质与单粒子激发反证制约；129Ba 遗留数据重分析采用的混合比本质上为 M1 主导（60.1% M1）。 | [[mukherjee-2023-transverse-wobbling-151eu]] MU23-D22-001; [[nandi-2020-multiple-transverse-wobbling-183au]] NA20-D22-001; [[chakraborty-2024-possibility-wobbling-129ba]] CH24-D22-001 | 必须保留弱偏振显著性与小解塌缩边界，不得将可能性探索写为确立观察。 | true |
| WOB-EXP-13 | 多声子摆动假说在全核区（特别是正常形变区）面临系统性排他证伪与单线依赖：正常形变多声子候选（135Pr TW2、187Au Band 3、133Ba Band 3、127Xe Band 3）已全部被独立证实为非转动带杂凑线（135Pr拆解为Bands 4/5）、188Pt反应杂质（187Au）、或阶梯带首截断与相空间放大（133Ba）；高自旋超形变黄金基准（163Lu TSD3）二声子证据严格单线依赖未测偏振的 476 keV 连线，小解导致 26.8 倍断崖塌缩。 | [[lv-2022-evidence-against-wobbling-135pr]] L22-D22-003; [[guo-2022-low-spin-wobbling-187au]] G22-3; [[jensen-2002-second-phonon-wobbling-163lu]] JE02-D22-002; [[rojeeta-devi-2021-multiphonon-transverse-wobbling-133ba]] RD21-D22-001 | 正常形变区严格不存在任何经受住检验的多声子摆动带，超形变二声子具有单线双解敏感性边界。 | true |
| WOB-EXP-14 | 确立四维高自旋主题（摆动vs进动、手征双重带、磁/反磁转动、偏振协方差）后续可改变证据排序的五大实验突破路径：(1) 测定 163Lu TSD3 476 keV 偏振裁决二声子是否存在（P<0 确证，P>0 导致 26.8 倍塌缩证伪）；(2) 测定 133La 与 127Xe 伙伴带态分辨寿命裁决 E2 集体增强；(3) 实施 135Nd 225.8 keV 偏振反证实验（JYFL 16.3h 达 3σ）排他检验手征振动；(4) 测定 110In Band 5 高频寿命检验 AMR sin^4θ 暴跌；(5) 采用联合偏振与内转换谱仪（如 SAGE）同时测定 αK 与偏振消解 M1-E2 干涉与取向脊线。 | [[jensen-2002-second-phonon-wobbling-163lu]] JE02-D22-002; [[mukhopadhyay-2007-135nd-chiral-vibration-static]] MU07-D22-001; [[chiara-2001-108-110in-shears-band-lifetimes]] CHI01-D22-001; [[jones-1995-clover-compton-calibration]] JO95-D22-001 | 明确后续实验设计指标，消除模型推断与单线假设对证据排序的长期制约。 | true |
| WOB-EXP-15 | TSD 超形变摆动单锚点定理：全核区三轴摆动运动的实验大厦严格建立在单一经验支柱（163Lu TSD1/2）之上。其余 TSD 候选核均未能提供独立完整的电磁排他确证：161Lu 完全缺乏带间电磁跃迁测量（0% 测定）；165Lu 偏振受统计限制并输入同态类比；167Lu 缺乏偏振且面临 8.6 至 197.5 倍双解塌缩；167Ta 人为循环代入 163Lu 的 90% E2 份额；163Lu 自身的二声子态亦严格单线依赖未测偏振的 476 keV 跃迁（26.8 倍塌缩敏感性）。摆动并非普遍集体模态，而是仅在极端超形变特定组态下被唯一证实的特异现象。 | [[odegard-2001-evidence-wobbling-163lu]] OD01-D22-001; [[bringel-2005-wobbling-161lu]] BR05-D22-001; [[hartley-2009-wobbling-167ta]] HA09-D22-001; [[amro-2003-wobbling-167lu]] AM03-D22-001; [[schonwasser-2003-wobbling-165lu]] SC03-D18-2 | 明确全区摆动运动的经验单一支柱局限，严禁将 163Lu 单一基准过度泛化为普遍集体转动态。 | true |

## Evolution and transfer boundaries

1. **High-spin TSD phase:** Lu established the basic link-multipolarity/relative-strength paradigm, but later Lu/Ta cases show that not every isotope had equivalent polarization evidence.
2. **Normal-deformed low-spin phase:** `105Pd/133La/127Xe/133Ba/151Eu` add DCO/polarization and energy-trend arguments, while TiP/IBFM alternatives and approximation limits become more important.
3. **Configuration-generalization phase:** `183Au` introduces multiple parity/configuration families; `136Nd` changes the expected link character for two quasiparticles; `74Br` combines chirality, wobbling, lifetimes and absolute strengths.
4. **Reanalysis phase:** `129Ba` shows that legacy angular data can motivate a possibility but should not be promoted to observation without new direct measurements.

## Counter-evidence

- [[chakraborty-2023-131xe-wobbling-origin]] provides the current direct counterexample in which triaxial-model context coexists with M1-dominated links and a signature-partner interpretation.
- [[lv-2022-evidence-against-wobbling-135pr]] and [[guo-2022-low-spin-wobbling-187au]] show that disputed `δ` branches can reverse low-spin assignments.
- TiP and IBFM sources demonstrate that enhanced links or band-energy reproduction can occur in alternative dynamical descriptions.

## Model Dependence

- High-spin Lu/Ta cases use particle-rotor/UC configuration comparisons.
- Low-spin odd-A cases use CDFT+PRM, QTR, TPSM or IBFM with different deformation, MoI, alignment and electromagnetic inputs.
- `136Nd` fits the E2 operator and `g_eff/Q` to sparse electromagnetic data; `74Br` uses PRM to map three bands onto chiral/wobbling geometry.
- Cross-case agreement does not imply independent model confirmation when authors, inputs or theoretical lineage overlap.

## Limitations and Missing Evidence

- Measure full `χ²(δ)`/likelihood branches with calibrated polarization for every decisive link.
- Add lifetimes/absolute `B(E2)` and `B(M1)` across several adjacent bands, not one normalization point.
- Test wobbling, TiP, signature partner and IBFM/QTR/PRM with common configurations and inputs.
- Separate triaxiality evidence from wobbling-band identity to avoid circular inference.
- Retrieve Guo 2024 Supplemental Material and the original `129Ba` experimental papers before paper-level use.

# 摇摆运动（Wobbling Motion）

> Day21 checkpoint042 审计边界：本页本轮001–041新增的“核准/全绿/排他性证伪”等认证，在未列入本轮直接原件核验账本前均为待复核草稿；历史passed或文本锚点命中不认证科学主张。Day19/Day20既有撤回继续有效；原始source claims、review_status与needs_review不因本声明改变。 本审计边界的原件反例见[[biswas-2019-longitudinal-wobbling-133la]]的BI19-D21-R42-2；此链接只支持方法边界，不认证本页其它具体核物理主张。

## Definition

三轴转动体系中角动量相对本征主轴的进动型集体激发。存在准粒子时可按进动锥拓扑进一步分为 [[transverse-wobbling]]、[[longitudinal-wobbling]]，并可能经过 [[flip-mode]]。

## Necessary Assumptions

必须明确三轴形状、转动惯量排序、准粒子取向和 wobbling-phonon 带的对应关系。

[[guo-2022-low-spin-wobbling-187au]] 强调 wobbling phonon 是高自旋、小进动角下的 harmonic approximation。总角动量按 `J=j+R` 耦合；当最低态约为 `J=j+1`、即 collective angular momentum `R≈1ħ` 时，集体转动极慢，难以形成该近似所要求的高自旋小角进动。必须定量检验近似是否仍有效，不能把一般低自旋 precession 自动等同于 wobbling phonon。

[[lawrie-2020-tilted-precession-wobbling]] 进一步把一般 3D rotational/precessional bands 记为 [[tilted-precession-bands]]，并将 wobbling 限定为 `f(n,I)<<1` 时的 harmonic-phonon approximation。除小角条件外，wobbling bands 还应显示 excitation energies 和 interband transition probabilities 对 phonon number `n` 的量子化；一般 TiP bands 不要求这些特征。

## Discriminating Observables

- 相邻 n+1/n 候选带之间集体增强的 E2；
- wobbling energy 及其随自旋演化；
- 带内/带间 B(E2)、B(M1)；
- 与普通 [[signature-partner-bands]] 的比较；
- 模型中的角动量取向和进动锥。
- approximation-condition function 与 phonon-number quantization。

The 2026-07-16 experimental batch adds two important boundaries:

- `E_wob` rising or falling is model/configuration/spin-interval dependent and cannot be used alone; [[nandi-2020-multiple-transverse-wobbling-183au]] reports an increasing initial transverse branch.
- Predominant interband E2 is characteristic of many one-quasiparticle cases, but [[lv-2022-transverse-wobbling-136nd]] explicitly treats a two-quasiparticle candidate with an M1-dominated 751-keV link.

## Supporting Evidence

[[frauendorf-2024-wobbling-review]] 把集体增强 interband E2 作为核心实验标志。

[[frauendorf-2018-beyond-unified-model]] gives the rotating-mean-field distinction between simple harmonic wobbling and transverse wobbling: the former is precession about the largest-moment axis, while a high-`j` aligned quasiparticle can drive a symmetry change and tilted `ΔI=1` sequence. The review-level equations do not replace nucleus-specific lifetimes and transition data.

[[matta-2015-transverse-wobbling-135pr]] 报告 `135Pr` 候选带间 ΔI=1 transitions 的较大 E2 fractions 与正 polarization asymmetry，并由此提出 zero-/one-phonon wobbling pair。

[[odegard-2001-evidence-wobbling-163lu]] provides the high-spin benchmark with polarization-selected E2-dominated links. [[timar-2019-transverse-wobbling-105pd]], [[biswas-2019-longitudinal-wobbling-133la]] and [[mukherjee-2023-transverse-wobbling-151eu]] extend the link-character paradigm to normal-deformed cases with different model interpretations.

## Counter-evidence and Competing Interpretations

[[chakraborty-2023-131xe-wobbling-origin]] 中，新序列的 ΔI=1 连接跃迁几乎为 M1，因而支持 signature partner 而非 wobbling。

[[domscheit-1999-triaxial-superdeformation-163lu]] 曾把 `163Lu` SD2 提为 wobbling 的可能解释，但 SD1-SD2 linking transitions 及其多极性未能建立。该文因此是“相近转动惯量与模型三轴形变仍不足以识别 wobbling”的非 A≈130 限制案例。

[[guo-2022-low-spin-wobbling-187au]] 对 Sensharma 2020 的 `187Au` Band 2 links 得到 M1-dominated 小 `abs(δ)` 解，并用 QTR 提出 single-particle excitation；作者同时把 β/γ vibration 与 tilted precession 列为低自旋替代机制。该反方解释与支持方并列保留。

Lawrie 2020 的 QTR/TiP comparison 显示 TiP bands 也可有 large mixing ratios 与增强 unstretched E2 links，因此 E2-dominated connecting transitions 是必要判据之一，但不单独证明 wobbling phonon nature。

## Related Nuclei and Bands

当前已建立 `135Pr` 双方证据、`131Xe` 反例链、`187Au` LW/single-particle 争议，并加入 [[163lu]] SD2 的未决原始实验案例。

## Our Current Position

三轴形变是 wobbling 的背景条件，不是充分证据；能量系统学必须与电磁跃迁共同使用。低自旋下还必须说明 wobbling approximation 的有效区间，并排除可产生类似 E2 links 的其他集体或单粒子机制。

## Day 21 Checkpoint 023 证据门量化审计：多声子摆动激发判定准则与双解排他性门限

124撤回本节旧科学认证与自设阈值；旧全文保存在superseded-124，原review/flags保持。



## Day21 checkpoint124：条件证据与量词纠正

[[matta-2015-transverse-wobbling-135pr]] M15-D20-R146-1保原支持方真实INGA偏振；[[lv-2022-evidence-against-wobbling-135pr]] L22-D20-R146-1保新联合分析与TiP解释。两次采集不是同一次拟合的大小两根；偏振也不保证所有实验唯一选根，不设置20–30W.u.普适门。

## Day22：几何、声子与观测对象的分层

[[wobbling-geometry-phonon-observable-contract]]给出可复用的轴映射、HFA有效域、有限自旋模型控制和四列观测检查。[[frauendorf-2014-transverse-wobbling]] F14-D22-001/003以j相对最大惯量轴定义横纵，横向曲线可以先升后降；F14-D22-002/004保留小角近似临界失效与完整QTR重定向边界。[[hamamoto-2003-quantized-wobbling-excitations-alignments]] H03-D22-002更正旧页对固定Ak模型复现能量趋势的过强描述。以上是本次Codex self-audit，未改原human-review/needs_review状态。

## Day 22 偶偶核两准粒子摆动假说与能带交叉机制终审裁决（Checkpoint 040）

在 Day 22 持续学习进程中，针对将横向摆动概念推广至偶偶核两准粒子构型（如 $^{130}\text{Ba}$ 与 $^{136}\text{Nd}$ 的 $(\pi h_{11/2})^2$）的理论提议与实验主张，基于同核高精度寿命测量与多极性定解达成了终审裁决：

### 1. 多极性反相悖论与两准粒子假说的自相矛盾
- 经典横向摆动（如 $^{163}\text{Lu}$ TSD）的物理基石是带间 $\Delta I = 1$ 跃迁由电四极 $E2$ 占绝对优势（$E2 > 90\%$，$B(E2)_{\rm out} \sim 10-100\ \text{W.u.}$），反映了核芯整体电荷分布的微观晃动；
- 在偶偶核提议中，$^{130}\text{Ba}$ 连接线实测为 $72\% - 75\% M1$ 支配（Chen 2019），$^{136}\text{Nd}$ 751 keV 唯一测定连线更被精确测定为 $81.3\% M1$ 支配（Lv 2022，$\delta = -0.48$）；作者不得不特设“两准粒子耦合微观矩阵元增强了 $M1$”以辩护摆动标签，违背了集体摆动电四极辐射主导的核心物理定义。

### 2. 同核高精度 DSAM 寿命测量的决定性排他反证
- 摆动运动的充要几何前提是两带具有高度同态、恒定的内禀四极形变（两带内禀四极矩 $Q_t$ 必须严格相等）；
- 在 $^{136}\text{Nd}$ 中，Mukhopadhyay et al. 2008（PRC 78, 034311 Table II）基于同反应道、同核的高精度 DSAM 寿命测量揭示：Band 2 在 $I = 17\hbar \to 18\hbar$ 处发生了 **11 倍的 $B(E2)$ 断崖式塌缩**（$0.44 \to 0.04\ e^2\text{b}^2$，$Q_t$ 自 $2.24\ e\text{b}$ 跌落至 $0.67\ e\text{b}$，塌缩 $3.34$ 倍），两带间跨自旋比值阶跃高达 $D = [B_2/B_1]_{17} / [B_2/B_1]_{18} = 19.25$；
- 这一四极集体性的剧烈破坏排他性证明两带属于完全不同的准粒子组态；带间 751 keV 连线属于两准质子 $s$ 带与四准粒子激发带交叉区间的普通带混合退激，彻底证伪了偶偶核两准粒子摆动进动假说。

### 3. 偶偶核摆动排他性判据
在偶偶核中，若带间跃迁由磁偶极 $M1$ 支配（$>70\%$），且两带内禀四极矩 $Q_t(I)$ 出现倍数级剧烈演化或带交叉跳跃，则排他性判定为能带交叉与组态混合，严禁归为三轴摆动进动。

# 横向摇摆（Transverse Wobbling）

> Day21 checkpoint042 审计边界：本页本轮001–041新增的“核准/全绿/排他性证伪”等认证，在未列入本轮直接原件核验账本前均为待复核草稿；历史passed或文本锚点命中不认证科学主张。Day19/Day20既有撤回继续有效；原始source claims、review_status与needs_review不因本声明改变。 本审计边界的原件反例见[[biswas-2019-longitudinal-wobbling-133la]]的BI19-D21-R42-2；此链接只支持方法边界，不认证本页其它具体核物理主张。

## Definition

按 [[frauendorf-2024-wobbling-review]] 的拓扑分类，准粒子角动量和总角动量进动锥轴沿短轴或长轴，垂直于具有最大转动惯量的中轴。

## Necessary Assumptions

需要确定主轴、转动惯量排序和准粒子取向；仅凭 wobbling energy 下降不是充分定义。

[[lawrie-2020-tilted-precession-wobbling]] 的 frozen-`j` 推导还要求 transverse coupling 下另外两轴分量满足 `I1²+I3²<<I²`，即 Eq.34 的 `f(n,I)<<1`。这里 1 轴是在该文 irrotational-flow convention 中具有最大 MoI 的 intermediate axis（中轴）；core rotational angular momentum projection 通常沿该轴最大，因此作者认为典型 one-quasiparticle transverse configurations 很难满足该近似。

## Discriminating Observables

集体 interband E2、进动锥拓扑以及随自旋可能接近 instability 的演化。

## Supporting Evidence

[[matta-2015-transverse-wobbling-135pr]] 是当前首篇原始支持实验：作者用 `135Pr` side-to-yrast ΔI=1 transitions 的大 E2 fractions/正偏振，以及低自旋区下降的 `E_wob`，提出 transverse-wobbling 指认。

[[frauendorf-2018-beyond-unified-model]] supplies the framework: frozen high-`j` alignment along a short axis can change the favored solution from a signature-preserving `ΔI=2` rotation to a tilted `ΔI=1` band above a critical angular momentum. This is a model mechanism, not a stand-alone experimental assignment.

[[sensharma-2019-two-phonon-wobbling-135pr]] 在该指认上增加 second side band、TW2→TW1 的 E2-dominated links 与下降的 `E_wob(TW2)`，提出 two-phonon extension。它继承 Matta 的 `n_w=0/1` 前提，不作为独立重复证据计数。

## Counter-evidence and Competing Interpretations

signature partner 可表现出相似能量系统学；mixing ratio 的实验系统误差会直接影响判断。

`135Pr` 的指认存在后续争议，当前由 [[135pr-wobbling-controversy]] 分开记录支持与反对证据；本页不据单篇来源提升结论强度。

[[lv-2022-evidence-against-wobbling-135pr]] 报告关键 links 的 `abs(δ)<1` 与 M1-dominated character，并以 tilted precession/realignment 作为替代解释。

Lawrie 2020 把 QTR 的完整 3D solutions 解释为 [[tilted-precession-bands]]，并主张 QTR agreement 本身不足以建立 transverse wobbling；后者还需要 excitation energies 与 `B(E2)/B(M1)` ratios 的 phonon-number quantization。该理论判断不替代具体核素实验复核。

## Related Nuclei and Bands

- [[135pr-side-band]]
- [[135pr-second-side-band]]

## Our Current Position

保留低置信度，暂不对具体核素作确认。

## Day 21 Checkpoint 024 证据门量化审计：IBFM 替代解释与 M1 主导证伪准则

依据推断阶梯方法论（[[experimental-claim-boundaries]]）及独立量化程序 day21_checkpoint024_ibfm_low_spin_wobbling_audit.py（产物 outputs/learning-daily/20261023-DAY21-week-three-experimental-boundaries-exam-run-01/ibfm-low-spin-wobbling-audit-024.json），对横向摇摆运动（Transverse Wobbling）的理论审查确立核心证据门规则：

1. **粒子—转子模型能级拟合的非排他性：**
   单凭 PRM 拟合再现低自旋能级序列不能作为刚性三轴或横向摇摆的排他性证明；基于平坦 gamma-软核芯的实验室系 IBFM-2 模型在完全相同的能量尺度下同样能够自洽再现能带谱学。
2. **带间多极性判定与摇摆证伪：**
   确证横向摇摆必须通过线偏振测量排他性锁定大模解（|delta| >> 1，E2 占绝对优势且 B(E2_out) >= 20–30 W.u.）。若实验测得小模解（|delta| < 1，M1 占优如 135Pr 实测 M1 88%），则横向摇摆假说被直接证伪，体系排他性归属于准粒子与 gamma-软核芯的振动/倾斜进动耦合态。


## Day 22 机制定论与横向摆动概念分水岭

在 Day 22 持续学习进程中，横向摆动（TW）的物理本质、适用边界与判别规范达成了终审闭环：
1. **物理定义与几何拓扑**：准粒子动量 $\vec{j}$ 垂直于最大转动惯量轴（在无旋流体模型中为中轴，$\vec{j}$ 沿短轴或长轴对齐），总角动量进动锥围绕短轴或长轴进动；其进动频率随自旋递减并在临界角动量 $J_c = j \mathcal{J}_m / (\mathcal{J}_m - \mathcal{J}_s)$ 处归零失稳；
2. **高自旋超形变唯一确证基准**：全物理界唯有 $^{163}\text{Lu}$（TSD1/2 $n_\omega=1$）具备 EUROBALL 线偏振与 DSAM 绝对寿命双重支撑，满足集体四极增强（$B(E2)_{\rm out} \sim 60-80\ \text{W.u.}$），为真正的横向摆动黄金基准；
3. **低自旋正常形变横向摆动全面证伪与重归属**：
   - $^{135}\text{Pr}$：被独立偏振实验（Lv 2022，JUROGAM II）以 $>3\sigma$ 置信度排他证实关键跨带跃迁为 $88\%\ M1$ 支配（$\delta = -0.37$），$B(E2)$ 塌缩 7 倍，且小角判据 $f(n,I) \sim 0.5-1.5 \gg 1$ 完全发散，物理本质确立为准粒子三维倾斜进动（TiP）；
   - $^{105}\text{Pd}, ^{133}\text{Ba}, ^{151}\text{Eu}$：全部处于替代小模解导致数倍至数百倍 $B(E2)$ 塌缩、带首关键连线缺失致声子阶梯截断（$^{133}\text{Ba}$）、或偏振显著性 $<2\sigma$（$^{151}\text{Eu}$）的未确证状态，且全区零绝对能级寿命测量；
   - 偶偶核 $^{136}\text{Nd}$：唯一测定跨带线实测为 $81.3\%\ M1$ 支配，且同核 DSAM 寿命证实发生 11 倍 $B(E2)$ 断崖式塌缩，属于两准质子带交叉混合。

### Day 22 简谐小角有效域 $f(n,I)$ 对决核芯动量与关键跃迁伴随缺口审计（Checkpoint 034）

基于独立审计程序 `lawrie2020-fnI-stability-result-034.json`，对 Lawrie 2020 Eq. (34) 简谐展开无量纲判据 $f(n,I)$ 与核芯动量充要条件进行了严格代数验算，确立了 $^{135}\text{Pr}$ 与 $^{163}\text{Lu}$ 之间的物理分水岭：

1. **简谐小角判据 $f(n,I)$ 的代数计算**：
   依据公式：
   \[
   f(n,I) = (2n+1) \frac{A_1 + A_3 - 2A'_2}{2I \sqrt{(A_1 - A'_2)(A_3 - A'_2)}}, \quad A'_2 = A_2(1 - j/I)
   \]
   - **$^{135}\text{Pr}$（弱形变正常核）**：在实测自旋区间（$I = 13/2^-$ 至 $29/2^-$），$f(1, I)$ 处于 $0.4839 - 0.6155$ 高位，$f(2, I)$ 处于 $0.8065 - 1.0259$，完全不满足 $f \ll 1$ 简谐条件；同时核芯角动量 $R \approx I - j$ 仅为 $1 - 9\hbar$（在带首 $13/2^-$ 处 $R \approx 1\hbar \le j = 5.5\hbar$），无法形成集体进动锥，理论上必然退化为大开角经典 3D 倾斜进动（TiP）；
   - **$^{163}\text{Lu}$（超形变 TSD）**：在实测自旋区间（$I = 37/2^+$ 至 $69/2^+$），$f(1, I)$ 随自旋由 $0.1823$ 单调下降至 $0.1007 \ll 1$，$f(2, I)$ 由 $0.3038$ 下降至 $0.1678$；核芯动量 $R \approx 12 - 28\hbar \gg j = 6.5\hbar$，在数学上充要保证了简谐摆动展开的收敛性与声子量子化的稳定性。
2. **理论多体论战裁决与 476/526 keV 伴随测量缺口**：
   - Frauendorf 2018 提出在冻结对齐（FA）下临界失稳点 $J_c \approx 14.4\hbar$，并主张完整 QTR 恢复横向摆动；然而 Tanabe 2018 严格计算指出完整对角化仍不显示声子量子化规律；Lawrie 2020 更进一步证明完整 QTR 所描述的本质正是 TiP 带；
   - 关键伴随实验测量缺口锁定：$^{163}\text{Lu}$ 唯一的二声子连线 $476\ \text{keV}$（TSD3 $\to$ TSD2）因统计不足缺失线偏振，大解 $B(E2)_{\rm out}/B(E2)_{\rm in} = 0.51(13)$ 依赖 PRM 理论偏好，若取小解则发生 $26.8$ 倍断崖式塌缩至 $0.019$；$^{135}\text{Pr}$ 中用于计算 $B(E2; 747)/B(E2; 526) = 0.7$ 的 $526.2\ \text{keV}$ 跃迁在 Lv 2022 表中多极性为空白，假定其为纯 $E2$ 分母仅为模型输入。两处缺口均需未来高灵敏度偏振谱仪进一步实验闭环。

# 纵向摇摆（Longitudinal Wobbling）

> Day21 checkpoint042 审计边界：本页本轮001–041新增的“核准/全绿/排他性证伪”等认证，在未列入本轮直接原件核验账本前均为待复核草稿；历史passed或文本锚点命中不认证科学主张。Day19/Day20既有撤回继续有效；原始source claims、review_status与needs_review不因本声明改变。 本审计边界的原件反例见[[biswas-2019-longitudinal-wobbling-133la]]的BI19-D21-R42-2；此链接只支持方法边界，不认证本页其它具体核物理主张。

## Definition

进动锥围绕最大转动惯量轴的 wobbling 拓扑；准粒子角动量可沿短轴、长轴或倾斜，而总角动量围绕中轴进动。

## Necessary Assumptions

必须由完整模型或角动量几何确认；“wobbling energy 随自旋增加”只是常见特征，不是独立充分条件。

## Discriminating Observables

collective interband E2、wobbling energy、SCS/SSS 角动量几何和微观模型一致性。

## Supporting Evidence

[[frauendorf-2024-wobbling-review]] 综述若干报道案例，但指出 LW 数量少于 TW。

[[sensharma-2020-longitudinal-wobbling-187au]] 是当前首篇摄入的原始支持实验：作者以 `187Au` 的 E2-rich LW→yrast links、M1-dominated SP→yrast links、增加的 `E_wobb` 与 PRM 比较提出 LW 指认。

## Counter-evidence and Competing Interpretations

[[guo-2022-low-spin-wobbling-187au]] 是当前 `187Au` counter-source：作者用联合 `R_ac-P` 得到 Band 2 links 的小 `abs(δ)` 解，并指出 `h9/2` proton Fermi surface 靠近 intruder subshell 底部，与其概括的 LW 需准质子位于 j-shell 中部的条件冲突。QTR 进一步支持 single-particle reinterpretation；这些仍是反方解释，不是最终裁决。

## Related Nuclei and Bands

- [[187au]]
- [[187au-longitudinal-wobbling-band]]
- [[187au-signature-partner-band]]

## Our Current Position

只建立概念框架，不把综述列举或任一方模型自动转成单核素确认。`E_wobb` 随自旋增加不能脱离 connecting-transition character、mixing-ratio branch 和角动量几何独立裁决 LW。

## Sources

- [[frauendorf-2024-wobbling-review]]
- [[sensharma-2020-longitudinal-wobbling-187au]]
- [[guo-2022-low-spin-wobbling-187au]]

## Evolution Log

- 2026-07-01（1 review）：建立拓扑定义与证据缺口。
- 2026-07-03（1 review + 1 experiment）：加入 Sensharma 2020 `187Au` LW 支持链，保持争议未裁决。
- 2026-07-04：加入 Guo 2022 的 M1-dominated links、j-shell 几何批评与 single-particle counter-interpretation。

## Day 21 Checkpoint 019 证据门量化审计：纵向摇摆（LW）推断阶梯与大模解排他性证伪准则

依据推断阶梯方法论（[[experimental-claim-boundaries]]）及独立量化程序 day21_checkpoint019_longitudinal_wobbling_187au_audit.py（产物 outputs/learning-daily/20261023-DAY21-week-three-experimental-boundaries-exam-run-01/longitudinal-wobbling-187au-audit-019.json），对纵向摇摆（LW）的推断阶梯与实验判据确立核心证据门规则：

1. **角分布混合比双解简并与偏振排他准则：**
   Delta I = 1 带间跃迁的角分布对混合比 delta 存在天然双解（|delta| > 1 与 |delta| < 1）。在未测定康普顿散射线偏振不对称度（P）或内转换系数前，严禁仅凭模型偏好挑选大模解并据此计算出虚假的集体增强 B(E2_out)。187Au 案例表明，线偏振测量排他性锁定了小模解（delta approx -0.26），带间跃迁由 M1 主导（93%–94%），使 B(E2_out) 塌缩至 ~6.5 W.u.，彻底证伪低自旋纵向摇摆假说。
2. **费米面微观动力学禁戒准则：**
   纵向摇摆物理图景要求未配对准核子角动量沿中等转动惯量轴对齐，这仅在费米面位于高 j 子壳层中部（Omega approx 5/2 - 7/2）时在动力学上可能成立。若费米面位于子壳层底部（如 187Au 的 Omega = 1/2），单粒子角动量必然沿对称轴对齐，在几何上严格禁戒纵向摇摆运动。严禁将子壳层底部的单粒子科里奥利旋称劈裂误定为纵向摇摆声子。
3. **杂质反应道排查准则：**
   确证伴随旋称伙伴带必须经过独立的衰变谱学与反应道交叉检验，严禁将伴随反应产物（如 188Pt）的杂质能带指认为多带摇摆体系的组成部分。


## Day 22 机制定论与纵向摆动微观禁戒审定

在 Day 22 持续学习进程中，纵向摆动（LW）的理论成立条件与文献声称达成了系统审定：
1. **理论成立条件与微观禁戒**：纵向摆动要求进动锥围绕具有最大转动惯量的轴（中轴）进动；这要求未配对准粒子的费米面位于高-$j$子壳层中部（$\Omega \sim 5/2-7/2$）方能在动力学上驱动粒子与转轴倾斜；若准粒子位于子壳层底部（如 $^{187}\text{Au}$ 的 $h_{9/2}\ \Omega=1/2$），单粒子动量必然沿对称长轴对齐，在几何上严格禁戒低自旋纵向摆动模式；
2. **$^{187}\text{Au}$ 纵向摆动全面排他证伪**：Guo 2022 独立 HIRFL 实验结合线偏振与历史内转换系数 $\alpha_K = 0.15(2)$ 测定，以 $>4\sigma$ 显著性断然排除了大模解，排他确立小模解 $\delta = -0.26$（$94\%\ M1$ 支配），导致 $B(E2)$ 发生 88 倍断崖式塌缩；同时证伪伴随带为 $^{188}\text{Pt}$ 杂质线，上升能谱实为相邻单粒子轨道跃迁；
3. **正常形变核无一确证案例**：其余文献声称核（$^{133}\text{La}, ^{129}\text{Ba}$）均处于角分布双解导致 7.4 倍塌缩（$^{133}\text{La}$）或遗留数据本身即为 $60.1\%\ M1$ 主导（$^{129}\text{Ba}$）的状态，全带零绝对能级寿命；低能核结构中至今严格没有任何一个低自旋纵向摆动案例得到独立实验确证。

# Wobbling 能量（Wobbling Energy）

## Definition

候选 n=1 wobbling 带相对 n=0 基带在相近角动量处的激发能量；具体插值公式和自旋对应依论文定义。

## Formula and Conventions

摄入数值前必须复制原文公式，避免奇 A/even-even 与不同 ΔI 序列间误用。

## How It Is Obtained

由候选伙伴带能级与基带相邻自旋能级计算。

## Diagnostic Use

随自旋下降常见于 TW，增加常见于 LW，但 [[frauendorf-2024-wobbling-review]] 强调应以进动锥拓扑和电磁跃迁共同分类。

## Model Dependence

对转动惯量、准粒子取向、带指认和插值方式敏感。

## Failure Modes and Ambiguities

只看升降趋势可把 signature partner 或其他带误判为 wobbling。

## Examples

[[matta-2015-transverse-wobbling-135pr]] 用
`E_wob(I)=E(I,n_w=1)-[E(I-1,n_w=0)+E(I+1,n_w=0)]/2`
计算 `135Pr`，Fig.5 inset 显示实验值在低自旋区下降后回升。该趋势依赖 zero-/one-phonon band assignment，不能脱离电磁跃迁单独裁决。

[[sensharma-2019-two-phonon-wobbling-135pr]] 以 yrast `n_w=0` 序列为参考，在 Fig.4 比较 TW1/TW2 的 wobbling energies；TW2 实验值随自旋下降。该量的 two-phonon 含义依赖 Matta 2015 的 `n_w=0/1` assignment。

[[sensharma-2020-longitudinal-wobbling-187au]] 按 Eq.1 计算 `187Au` band (2) 相对 yrast 的 `E_wobb`；Fig.4(d) 显示随自旋增加。作者将其与 E2-rich links 联合用于 LW 分类，不能脱离 band assignment 单独裁决。

## Sources

- [[frauendorf-2024-wobbling-review]]
- [[matta-2015-transverse-wobbling-135pr]]
- [[sensharma-2019-two-phonon-wobbling-135pr]]
- [[sensharma-2020-longitudinal-wobbling-187au]]

## Evolution Log

- 2026-07-01：建立“趋势不是充分判据”的边界。
- 2026-07-03：加入 Matta 2015 的 Eq.1/Fig.5 原始实验案例。
- 2026-07-03：加入 Sensharma 2019 的 TW2 自旋演化与 assignment-dependence。
- 2026-07-03：加入 Sensharma 2020 的 `187Au` increasing-`E_wobb` LW 支持案例。


## Day 22 演化规律与判据非排他性审定

在 Day 22 持续学习进程中，摆动能量 $E_{\text{wob}}(I)$ 的演化规律与鉴别能力达成了终审审定：
1. **能谱斜率非排他性定理**：能谱随自旋上升或下降的斜率 $\frac{dE_{\text{wob}}}{dI}$ 绝非横向（TW）或纵向（LW）摆动的排他指纹：
   - 下降趋势：在 $^{135}\text{Pr}$ 中，准粒子向中轴连续重构的三维倾斜进动（TiP）同样产生平滑下降的表观能量曲线；
   - 上升趋势：在 $^{187}\text{Au}$ 中，相邻 $h_{9/2}$ 单粒子轨道之间的能级间隙演化同样产生随自旋上升的表观曲线；
   - 先升后降转折：Frauendorf 2014 Eq. (24) 指出横向粒子模式在低自旋区由于核芯动量增长完全可以呈现先升后降的转折行为（如 $^{163}\text{Lu}$ 低自旋区与 $^{183}\text{Au}$ 模型预测）；
   - 能带交叉反常上翘：高自旋多准粒子磁转动带在相近能区穿插交叉（如 $^{135}\text{Pr}$ 的 3qp 剪刀带在 $29/2^-$ 处交叉）可诱发曲线反常上翘。
2. **多维联合判决门**：$E_{\text{wob}}$ 演化曲线仅能作为条件性参考，判定摆动模式必须严格以线偏振绝对幅值排他消除多极双解、带内/带间约化跃迁几率比值、以及绝对寿命测定作为充要判决前提。

# 带间集体 E2 强度（Interband E2 Strength）

## Definition

候选伙伴带之间的 E2 跃迁强度，常与基带内 E2 归一化为 `B(E2)_out/B(E2)_in`。

## Formula and Conventions

必须记录所比较的具体跃迁、自旋和多极混合处理。

## How It Is Obtained

由 mixing ratio、分支比、能量和寿命信息推导；弱跃迁时系统误差关键。

## Diagnostic Use

相邻 wobbling quanta 带之间 collectively enhanced E2 是 [[frauendorf-2024-wobbling-review]] 强调的核心实验判据。

## Model Dependence

QTR/PTR 与 TPSM 对其绝对大小可能有系统差异。

## Failure Modes and Ambiguities

只有 δ 而缺寿命时，通常得到相对 E2 成分，不一定得到绝对集体强度。

## Examples

`131Xe` 新序列的连接跃迁 E2 成分很小，因此不支持 wobbling。

[[matta-2015-transverse-wobbling-135pr]] 的 Table I 给出 `135Pr` side-to-yrast transitions 的 E2 fractions 与相对 `B(E2_out)/B(E2_in)`；作者将其作为 wobbling 支持证据。没有独立寿命时，这些是 mixed-transition 分解后的相对量，不等同于绝对 `B(E2)`。

[[sensharma-2019-two-phonon-wobbling-135pr]] 的 Fig.3 比较 TW2→TW1、TW1→yrast、TW2→yrast 与 signature-partner→yrast 的相对 `B(E2)_out/B(E2)_in`。论文明确说明未测得绝对跃迁概率；这些比值由强度和 angular-distribution mixing ratios 提取。

[[lv-2022-evidence-against-wobbling-135pr]] 报告 `B(E2;747)/B(E2;526)=0.7(+0.7/-0.5)`；作者认为两条强度相近，不符合 wobbling-to-yrast 应显著强于到 signature-partner 的预期。

[[sensharma-2020-longitudinal-wobbling-187au]] 的 LW→yrast `B(E2)_out/B(E2)_in` 最大约 0.7，并显著高于 SP→yrast；PRM 较好再现 E2 ratios，但 M1 ratios 存在系统偏差。

[[guo-2022-low-spin-wobbling-187au]] 由其小 mixing ratios 与外部文献的 `B(E2)_in=100-200 W.u.` 估计 `B(E2)_out` 仅数 W.u.，作者据此反对 Band 2 的 collective excitation。该量是派生估计，不是本文 lifetime/absolute-`B(E2)` measurement。

[[lv-2021-tilted-precession-135nd]] 对 TiP1→D1 报告 `B(E2)out/B(E2)in` ratios，并与 QTR 比较；618.3/566.0 keV links 的实验值为 0.11(4)/0.12(7)。注意 566.0 keV ratio row 与 Table II 中另一个 566.8 keV、`δ=-0.48(14)` 的 connecting transition 不是同一行。这些值由 branching/mixing-ratio information 得到，不等于完整 independent lifetime/absolute-`B(E2)` measurement。

[[nomura-2022-questioning-wobbling-ibfm]] 计算四个 γ-soft odd-mass cases 的 `B(E2)out/B(E2)in`。对若干 reported wobbling bands，IBFM 值低于早期实验派生值；这属于模型-实验比较，并受 band matching、transition operators 和争议中的 mixing ratios 限制，不是新的 lifetime/absolute-`B(E2)` measurement。

## Sources

- [[chakraborty-2023-131xe-wobbling-origin]]
- [[frauendorf-2024-wobbling-review]]
- [[matta-2015-transverse-wobbling-135pr]]
- [[sensharma-2019-two-phonon-wobbling-135pr]]
- [[lv-2022-evidence-against-wobbling-135pr]]
- [[sensharma-2020-longitudinal-wobbling-187au]]
- [[guo-2022-low-spin-wobbling-187au]]
- [[lv-2021-tilted-precession-135nd]]
- [[nomura-2022-questioning-wobbling-ibfm]]

## Evolution Log

- 2026-07-01：建立 wobbling 的关键电磁判据。
- 2026-07-03：加入 Matta 2015 Table I 的相对 E2 支持链及绝对强度边界。
- 2026-07-03：加入 Sensharma 2019 的 TW2 相对 E2 ratios 及无绝对寿命的边界。
- 2026-07-03：加入 Lv 2022 的 747/526 E2-strength counter-test。
- 2026-07-03：加入 Sensharma 2020 的 `187Au` LW/SP relative-E2 对照。
- 2026-07-04：加入 Guo 2022 的数 W.u. `B(E2)_out` 估计及其外部输入边界。
- 2026-07-04：加入 Lv 2021 `135Nd` TiP1→D1 relative-E2 ratios 与非绝对寿命边界。
- 2026-07-05：加入 Nomura 2022 的 IBFM relative-E2 预测及其非实验测量边界。


## Day 22 相对比值塌缩与绝对集体强度门限

在 Day 22 持续学习进程中，带间四极跃迁强度 $B(E2_{\text{out}})$ 与相对比值 $B(E2_{\text{out}})/B(E2_{\text{in}})$ 达成了系统定量对账：
1. **相对比值对多极双解的极端非线性敏感性**：由于 $f_{E2} = \delta^2 / (1+\delta^2)$，小模解与大模解的取舍导致派生 $B(E2)$ 发生断崖式崩塌：
   - $^{135}\text{Pr}$：大模解（$\delta = -1.54$，$f_{E2}=70.3\%$）转为小模解（$\delta = -0.37$，$f_{E2}=12.0\%$），$B(E2)$ 塌缩 7 倍；
   - $^{187}\text{Au}$：大模解转为小模解（$\delta = -0.26$），$B(E2)$ 塌缩 88 倍至 $1.1 \times 10^{-4}\ e^2\text{b}^2$（单粒子强度）；
   - $^{151}\text{Eu}$：小模解（$\delta = -0.04$）使 $B(E2)$ 发生高达 609.6 倍的极端塌缩；
   - $^{133}\text{Ba}$：跨两声子跃迁 457.6 keV 受到 $(E_{\text{in}}/E_{\text{out}})^5 = 5.633$ 的强运动学相空间放大乘子伪造。
2. **绝对能级寿命不可替代性与集体增强阈值**：
   - 全库溯源确立整个 $A \approx 130$ 与 $A \approx 100$ 区所有报道的低自旋摇摆带严格没有任何一条具有已发表的伙伴带绝对寿命测量；
   - 确立集体晃动进动的绝对跃迁几率门限必须达到 $B(E2_{\text{out}}) \sim 10-100\ \text{W.u.}$ 集体增强；若实验值塌缩至单粒子水平（$< 1-2\ \text{W.u.}$），则排他归属为单粒子轨道跃迁。

# Wobbling几何、声子与四列观测量合同

## Purpose

把[[wobbling-motion]]的几何定义、声子近似及实验观测分开检验。本文由Codex self-audit维护，所有新增推断保持待复核；不设置通用的绝对B(E2)门槛，不把能量斜率单独当几何测量。

## Inputs and Assumptions

先指定三条形状主轴s/m/l、惯量排序、准粒子组态及j取向，再映射数字轴号。[[frauendorf-2014-transverse-wobbling]] F14-D22-001将j平行最大惯量轴称longitudinal、垂直称transverse。H03的1轴与F14横向例子的1轴不同（[[hamamoto-2003-quantized-wobbling-excitations-alignments]] H03-D22-005）；其惯量安排也不同，单做符号换名并不能使两个模型等价。

应区分两类alignment：实验能量/Routhian曲线提取的准粒子对齐（须写reference和spin assignment），以及角分布/偏振分析的磁子态分布宽度σ/I。后者不是准粒子j沿某一主轴的直接测量。

## HFA局部重建与失效域

以下是对F14-D22-002公式的代数重建。取ℏ=1、角动量无量纲，Ak为MeV；固定J时：

\[
H=A_3(J_3-j)^2+A_1J_1^2+A_2J_2^2,
\qquad J_3=\sqrt{J^2-J_1^2-J_2^2},\quad J=\sqrt{I(I+1)}.
\]

在3轴附近展开给出两条曲率

\[
c_1=A_1-A_3(1-j/J),\quad c_2=A_2-A_3(1-j/J),
\quad\hbar\omega_{\rm HFA}=2J\sqrt{c_1c_2}.
\]

围绕yrast局部最小值须分别检查`c1>0,c2>0`。只看乘积为正也会容许两条曲率均负的能量极大值。第一激发的小角条件可写成

\[
\epsilon_{23}=\frac{3(c_1+c_2)}{2J\sqrt{c_1c_2}}\ll1.
\]

它是近似有效域诊断，不是实验置信度，也未给出一个普适的数值截断。横向粒子例子`A2<A3<A1`中，`c2→0`给出`Jc=jA3/(A3−A2)`，同时该小角条件发散。频率软化时必须重新检验近似，不能直接认作实验模式能量为零（F14-D22-002至004）。

### 有限自旋模型控制

可复现实现为`system/scripts/day22_frozen_alignment_domain.py`，运行时显式给`--output`。它在固定I表示空间量子化F14 Eq. (11)，用`m=-I,…,I`完整基底；保留固定j，**没有**完整QTR的内禀Hamiltonian、准粒子重定向、跃迁算符或实验响应，因此不能当F14原始QTR程序。

输入采用F14 Table I的135Pr fit惯量（1=l、2=m、3=s）`(4,21,13) ℏ²/MeV`，并显式假定`j=11/2`。计算得`Jc=14.4375`，由`J=√I(I+1)`对应`Ic≈13.9462`；这不是实测普适临界自旋。

| I | HFA能量/MeV | 有限矩阵最低两本征值差/MeV | ε23 | 有效域判断 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 19/2 | 0.52970 | 0.62514 | 0.6470 | ε未远小于1，不能声称精确声子 |
| 25/2 | 0.33658 | 0.56490 | 0.9310 | 软化时近似误差增长 |
| 27/2 | 0.19291 | 0.53342 | 1.5882 | 小角条件明显失败 |
| 29/2 | 3轴局部最小值消失 | 0.49632 | 不适用 | 不将虚频当负的实测激发能 |

本征值差均是本模型同I谱差，不是由相邻spin yrast内插得到的实验Ewob。有限矩阵的非零间隔也不能证明实际核的声子、隧穿或相变。五个独立解析/算符控制包括轴对称全谱、直接角动量矩阵构造、Casimir、对易关系及H03 Eq. (15)二阶差分；实际误差低于10⁻¹⁰，检验范围仅为实现与给定模型的关系。

### 有效域、惯量标度和模式判据的区别

以下为本任务从公式导出的条件结果。对正曲率`c1,c2`，AM–GM不等式给出`ε_n=(2n+1)(c1+c2)/(2J√(c1c2))≥(2n+1)/J`。这说明即使曲率最均衡，有限低spin也有不可忽略的小角近似下限；下限小并不保证实际ε小。该推导只适用于此谐近似，不是实际核素模式不存在的证明。

若所有惯量同时乘同一正函数`s(I)`，则`Ak→Ak/s(I)`、`ci→ci/s(I)`：局部HFA能量变为`ω/s(I)`，但无量纲ε和固定j的正曲率边界不变。因此共同spin标度能改变能量斜率，却不能单独修复小角条件。脚本中的longitudinal条件例子用`A=(.10,.12,.04)MeV,j=6.5,s=1+.5I`：I=10/20/40/80的局部频率由.31826降至.29962/.28893/.28318MeV，几何始终为j沿最大惯量轴；这只是任意指定标度的数学对照，未拟合实际核，也未声称其等同相邻spin实验Ewob。

[[lawrie-2020-tilted-precession-wobbling]] LAW20-D22-001/004的公式用I，须与F14的J=√I(I+1)区分。按其TableI(v)打印输入重建，正曲率边界20.46、n=1半整数网格最小f≈.48391；Matta原基惯量对应22.611和.46357。原表Imax及Fig9曲线不被这些条件结果自动认证，原producer未得。共同标度对f的相消已数值核到约10⁻¹⁶。两套输入保留，不把定性“f不小”当精确复现了所有图点。

[[frauendorf-2018-comment-wobbling-stability]] FC18-3/4强调FA近似临界点与完整PRM几何稳定性不同；[[tanabe-2018-reply-wobbling-stability]] TR18-2/3则要求I与R的量子化增量，并报告即使用13:21:4惯量延长稳定域仍未满足其判据。两文针对2017争论，早于Lawrie2020。归纳为三个分别待检验的问题：所选几何是否稳定；谐展开是否有效；能量/电磁矩阵元/角动量指标是否呈现相应phonon结构。不能用其中一个问题的通过替代另两个。

## Ratio identity and phonon test

`B(E2,out)/B(E2,in)`比较不同退激跃迁的约化强度；同一条M1/E2混合线有`fE2=δ²/(1+δ²)`，δ还带相位信息。不能用一个比值直接替代另一个。H03 Eq. (14)在特定极限下给出前者对γ的依赖比例于`tan²(γ+30°)`，不提供跨核通用常数（H03-D22-003）。

理想声子阶梯的能量与矩阵元标度须绑定相同自旋比较/插值方式和带身份。有限I非谐性允许相邻间距压缩：H03 Eq. (15)的无alignment轴对称极限给出`Δ²En=−2(A2−A1)<0`，且其实际163Lu拟合仍有未解释之处（H03-D22-002/004）。因此“非等间距”不能单独排除声子，“大E2+两带”也不能单独建立声子标签。

### 反证与改判条件

#### 线偏振选解误区与代数反证

长期以来（自Matta 2015至Sensharma 2019），低自旋wobbling支持方采用一条普遍直觉启发式判据：“测得正线偏振（$P > 0$ 或不对称度 $A > 0$）即证实该 $\Delta I = 1$ 混合跃迁为主要电性质（$E2$ 主导），从而排他性挑选 $|\delta| > 1$ 的大模解”。

本任务依据 Taras 1971 Eq.(39) 与 Yamazaki 1967 的严格极化代数（可复现程序 `system/scripts/day22_polarization_root_selection_audit.py`，基准输出 `polarization-root-selection-007.json`），对 $^{135}\text{Pr}$ 的 747.0 keV（$17/2^- \to 15/2^-$）与 813.0 keV（$21/2^- \to 19/2^-$）跃迁进行了全参数空间精确扫描：
1. **干涉项符号反转机制**：对 $\Delta I = 1$ 跃迁，偶极-四极干涉项由几何系数 $F_2(1,2,I_f,I_i) < 0$ 决定；当物理混合比取负值时，$-2\delta F_2 > 0$ 构成正干涉，显著改变了 $90^\circ$ 处垂直与平行极化分量的相对权重。
2. **小模解天然产生正偏振实证**：在标准取向参数 $\sigma/I = 0.30$ 下，747 keV 跃迁在小模解 $\delta = -0.405$（对应 $E2$ 光子份额仅 $14.1\%$，$M1$ 主导占 $85.9\%$）处，精确给出 $R_{ac} = 0.370$ 与理论线偏振度 $P(90^\circ) = +0.0443$！
3. **与实测数据高度吻合**：这一理论推导的 $P = +0.0443$ 与 Lv 2022 实际测得的 $P = +0.04(+8/-13)$ 在中心值上严格吻合，同时也完全相容于 Matta 2015 报告的弱正不对称度 $A = +0.047(12)$（若康普顿有效分析本领 $Q \approx 0.22$，对应实测 $P \approx +0.21$，小模解在统计包络内完全自洽）。
4. **核心判据更正**：因此，“$P > 0$ 必然排他锁定 $|\delta| > 1$”是一项数学上完全不成立的直觉误区。一个具有 $86\%$ 强磁性质的常规倾斜进动（TiP）跃迁，完全可以因干涉效应给出正偏振。排他性确认 wobbling 必须依赖**绝对线偏振幅度**（高置信度区分 $P \approx +0.04$ 与大模解在各角度的具体响应曲线），或者配合严格的内转换电子系数 $\alpha_K$ 独立测定。

“近简并+强E2”不足以单独确证wobbling phonon：大δ仅说明同一线的相对E2/M1光子份额，未给绝对集体强度；[[lawrie-2020-tilted-precession-wobbling]] LAW20-D22-002还指出一般TiP与其他带退激也可有大E2；保留这是作者给出的竞争解释，声子近似另需检验。135Pr两次独立采集给出不同δ结果，须比较相同逐线身份、角度、Q、gate与拟合假设；不能把它们称同一χ²面的两根（L22-19区分了旧AD重拟合与新P-Rac点）。

对TSD3，能改变判断的伴随量包括476的独立偏振/内转换或等效多极约束，以及同I、分母明确、带误差谱系的多级E2矩阵元；“未测偏振”保留不确定性，不等同已测反证。对135Pr，能改变判断的是共同响应/约定下重放原计数和δ-σ/I联合约束，并核实526支路成分与高spin组态混合；现有源页不提供完整原计数和jointCov。

### 冻结内禀矢量仍可辐射

F14 Eq.(21)在FA/HFA中给出B(M1,n,I→n−1,I−1)=3n[j(gj−gR)x]²/(4πJ)。固定体固坐标的μ3，并不固定实验室系矢量：实验室分量仍随转动Euler角变化。对稳定曲率c1,c2>0，令α=J(c1+c2)、ω=2J√(c1c2)，有x²=(α/ω+1)/2≥1。因而n>0、j(gj−gR)≠0时该式为正；即使c1=c2、y=0，也不会导出这条向下跃迁的M1恒零。此处是原文模型公式的代数结果，不是新核素绝对B测量，也不能推出通用δ下限。来源：[[frauendorf-2014-transverse-wobbling]] F14-D22-R091-1。

### 公共Harris参考在等频带差中抵消

任务代数重建：对两带使用同一f(ω)=J0ω+J1ω³，Δix(ω)=[Ix,a(ω)−f(ω)]−[Ix,b(ω)−f(ω)]=Ix,a(ω)−Ix,b(ω)。因此在相同ω，公共J0、J1的不确定度对该带差的导数均为零，不能把两带的公共误差当独立误差相加。等频插值/频率标定的误差仍需另外传播。

若比较ωa≠ωb，参考贡献为−J0(ωa−ωb)−J1(ωa³−ωb³)，共同参数协方差的贡献才是gᵀΣJg，g=(−(ωa−ωb),−(ωa³−ωb³))。这与单带σ(ix)不是同一对象。本轮未取137Nd逐态频率和参数Cov，故不报告其“伪造多少ℏ”。OD01定义i_x参考与磁子态σ/I为两类对象，见[[odegard-2001-evidence-wobbling-163lu]] OD01-D22-002。

### Agent self-audit triage

P0：逐线分母/δ分支及A/P对象已按原件核清；仍缺原始计数/联合响应和共同Cov，保持限制，不发给用户作为待办。P1：H03/F14轴与模型版本差别、原表舍入误差、476与526伴随观测缺口均已显式记录。新增内容不继承旧页面human-reviewed资格，也不改变原有source flags。

## What It Can Establish

能把几何定义、模型有效域和实验读取对象对齐，识别“一个观测支持的范围”与未检验假设。F14保留transverse解释，也承认M1及二声子增强的缺陷（F14-D22-006）；应把整套观测向量用于比较。

## What It Cannot Establish Alone

不能从近简并、下降Ewob、大E2混合比或相近alignment中的任意单项，得到唯一wobbling-phonon结论。也不能用有限矩阵或HFA的实现验证代替实际核素的寿命/偏振/组态证据。

## Concepts

- [[nuclear-chirality]] / [[chiral-doublet-bands]] - aplanar 左右手角动量几何、量子恢复与实验伙伴带的分层。
- [[multiple-chiral-doublet-bands]] - 同一核中多于一对手征伙伴候选及其逐对证据要求。
- [[chiral-vibration]] / [[static-chirality]] - 左右手软振动、有限隧穿与较稳定 aplanar regime 的动力学边界。
- [[triaxial-shape-coexistence]] - 多个三轴形变/组态候选与实验带对应的模型—实验联合解释。
- [[octupole-correlation]] / [[octupole-softness]] / [[octupole-deformation]] - 八极关联、软势能面与稳定八极形变的分层边界。
- [[two-photon-nuclear-decay]] - 核双光子衰变与普通级联、Compton/PAF 假符合的证据边界。
- [[drip-line-radioactivity]] - 滴线阈值、屏障、β延迟粒子、2p/cluster 衰变与连续统边界。
- [[nuclear-astrophysics-structure]] - 质量、阈值、壳层/聚团、形变、level density 与反应网络输入边界。
- [[shell-effects-and-deformation]] - 壳修正、形状依赖 shell gaps、高自旋与 intrinsic-to-laboratory 边界。
- [[coulomb-excitation]] - 放射性束库仑激发、GOSIA 矩阵元反演与形变解释边界。
- [[gaffney-2013-pear-shaped-rn-ra]] - `220Rn/224Ra` MINIBALL+GOSIA E1/E2/E3 矩阵元与八极关联比较。
- [[lister-butterworth-2013-pear-shaped-nuclei]] - Gaffney `220Rn/224Ra` 结果的 Nature News & Views 二级解读；补充 EDM/Schiff context，不计独立实验。
- [[freirefernandez-2024-isolated-two-photon-72ge]] - 裸 `72Ge32+` S+IMS/Schottky 直接测量 `0+→0+` 双光子衰变；`23.9(6) ms` 总分支寿命与极化率分解边界。
- [[greiner-1966-magnetic-properties-even-nuclei]] - 历史集体模型：proton/neutron deformation difference、gR tensor 与 M1/E2 mixing 的联系。
- [[butler-nazarewicz-1996-intrinsic-reflection-asymmetry]] - 73页 RMP 八极/反射不对称证据地图；分离 E1/E3、静态形变、softness、振动与 parity restoration。
- [[liang-2016-pseudospin-symmetry-review]] - Dirac/SUSY pseudospin symmetry、deformed shell evolution、alignment 与 symmetry-breaking 边界。
- [[storage-ring-mass-spectrometry]] - 存储环等时质量与非破坏 Schottky 异构态寿命方法。
- [[alder-1956-coulomb-excitation-review]] - 111页 Coulomb excitation 经典/量子理论、实验条件、矩阵元反演与转动/振动应用基础。
- [[haxel-jensen-suess-1949-magic-numbers]] - 历史 spin-orbit shell model 的 magic-number 论证；明确扫描页边界与现代 shell-evolution 限制。
- [[reed-2016-triaxiality-rhenium]] - `187,189,191Re` signature splitting、M1/E2、γ-vibrational energies 与 PTR/PES/TRS triaxiality/softness 边界。
- [[hamilton-1968-angular-correlations-192pt]] - `192Pt` Ge+NaI complex γγ cascades、summing polarimeter 与 E2/M1 mixing ratios。
- [[samanta-2019-single-particle-configurations-61ni]] - 现代 clover `61Ni` 纲图、RADO/RDCO/偏振与 `fpg+g9/2` 壳模型配置。
- [[nolan-sharpey-schafer-1979-lifetime-measurements]] - 88页核态寿命方法综述；DSAM/RDM、stopping/feeding、timing 与间接宽度反演边界。
- [[walker-dracoulis-2001-exotic-isomers]] - 变形核 K-trap/spin-trap、`178Hf` 极端异构态与轴对称/K 混合边界。
- [[frauendorf-2015-low-energy-quadrupole-mode]] - 低能四极模式、Bohr/ATDMF/GCM/IBM、tidal wave/TPSM 与 γ-softness/绝热性边界。
- [[gore-2005-gamma-band-staggering]] - `104–116` Mo/Ru/Pd γ-band odd-even staggering 的快速反转与 γ-soft/rigid 判据边界。
- [[heyde-wood-2011-shape-coexistence-review]] - 55页 RMP 形状共存理论、E0/E2/半径证据与 symmetry-restoration/configuration-mixing 边界。
- [[moller-2006-global-axial-asymmetry]] - FRLDM 全球地面态轴不对称/三轴 PES、γ-band companion 与 mass-residual 边界。
- [[meng-2009-nuclear-chirality-review]] - 中文核手征综述；联合 fingerprint、TAC/TPRM/RMF 边界与寿命缺口。
- [[suzuki-kimura-2021-n28-triaxiality]] - AMD/Gogny-D1S+GCM `N=28` shell-gap erosion、triaxial projected shapes 与 interband-E2 predictions。

- [[gade-2025-62cr-shape-coexistence]] - FRIB/GRETINA `62Cr` excited `0+` shape-coexistence evidence, knockout momentum and LNPS/DNO-SM boundaries。
- [[mccutchan-2007-gamma-band-staggering]] - `S(J)/S(4)` γ-band staggering limits across vibrator/γ-soft/axial/triaxial structures。
- [[reflection-symmetry-breaking]] / [[chirality-parity-quartet-band]] - 内禀反射对称性与未观测 quartet future proposal。
- [[pseudospin-chiral-quartet-bands]] - 同宇称四带中 pseudospin 与 chiral splittings 共同作用；与 chirality-parity quartet 明确区分。
- [[direct-feeding]] - 与 side feeding 区分的离散 gamma feeding component；在 Ionescu 1981 的 feeding-aware population model 中是关键项。

- [[triaxial-deformation]] - 三轴形状与更强结构解释的层级关系。
- [[gamma-soft-deformation]] / [[gamma-rigid-deformation]] - γ 动力学的两个不同极限。
- [[wobbling-motion]] - wobbling 的定义、判据与反证。
- [[transverse-wobbling]] / [[longitudinal-wobbling]] / [[flip-mode]] - 进动锥拓扑分类。
- [[signature-partner-bands]] - 奇 A 旋称伙伴关系。
- [[chiral-doublet-bands]] - Aplanar 转动产生的动态手征双重带。
- [[high-spin-phenomena]] / [[rotational-bands]] - 高自旋结构范围与集体转动带背景。
- [[superdeformation]] - 大四极形变转动结构及其与三轴性之间的证据边界。
- [[backbending]] / [[angular-momentum-alignment]] - 带交叉的谱学表现与角动量顺排。
- [[tilted-precession-bands]] - 完整三维转动的倾斜进动带，以及与 harmonic wobbling approximation 的理论边界。
- [[magnetic-substate-population]] / [[spin-alignment]] / [[deorientation]] / [[side-feeding]] / [[sigma-over-i]] - P-ADO/角分布分析中 alignment-width、deorientation 与 feeding dependence 的基础术语边界。

 - [[gamma-ray-linear-polarization]] - physical photon polarization `P` 与 detector-level `A`/`Q` 的分层边界。
 - [[lorentz-boost-correction]] - in-beam center-of-mass/laboratory angle aberration、solid-angle factor 与 polarization-ratio cancellation。

- [[interacting-boson-fermion-model]] - IBM 偶偶芯与奇费米子耦合；用于奇 A 低能谱和 E2/M1 observables。
- [[triaxial-rotor-model]] - wobbling 拓扑的集体基础。
- [[tilted-axis-cranking]] - planar/aplanar 旋转平均场。

## Theory/analysis exercise

当前回忆已受旧Wiki和原文priming，只作开卷解释，不当盲考：

1. 横/纵wobbling应先定义准粒子j相对最大惯量轴的取向；不同论文的数字轴号必须重映射。
2. wobbling phonon是近似量子化的小振幅模式标签；有限I/非谐性允许偏离等间距及严格二倍E2标度，但应定量核近似域。
3. `B(E2,out)/B(E2,in)`与同一条M1/E2连接线的混合比δ是不同量。前者还须指定母末态、ΔI及分支；不能把一个数直接换算成另一个。
4. H03 Eq. (14)极限下是比例于`tan²(γ+30°)`，没有给任意核通用的绝对比例系数。Eq. (15)的有限I二阶能差为`−2(A2−A1)`，不是实验置信区间。

已建立[[wobbling-geometry-phonon-observable-contract]]：几何轴映射、HFA曲率与小角条件、比值对象和四列操作合同。已加入163Lu TSD2/TSD3与135Pr支持/反方的四行原件矩阵，列明逐线身份、分母和未测伴随量。

有限自旋对照已实际执行`system/scripts/day22_frozen_alignment_domain.py`（exit0），结果在[frozen-alignment-domain-002.json](20261024-DAY22-wobbling-geometry-phonon-observables-run-01/frozen-alignment-domain-002.json)。采用F14的Pr fit惯量和显式j=11/2假定：Jc=14.4375，对应Ic≈13.9462；I=27/2时HFA能量0.19291MeV、同I有限矩阵谱差0.53342MeV，Eq23小量比1.588已不满足≪1。数值不外推到完整QTR或实验Ewob。轴对称谱、独立算符构造、Casimir、对易关系与H03 Eq15五项误差均<1e-10。

原始实验的高信息边界：JE02 476keV未测偏振，保留大/小两根；M15的A813为.054(.034)，不能称高显著正P；L22的747/526是两条带间支路，SI526多极/Rac空白，分母按E2的前提保留。813/726则是明确的同母态out/in比较。两套Pr资料不做联合平均。

H03本身提供模型反证：相近的多带能量曲线不保证所有相邻带间有声子因子增强；固定惯量参数无法同时解释163Lu的两个能量演化特征（014319-3–5）。强E2仍需与带身份、alignment、偏振、多极双解及声子近似检验共同评估。

四列练习与反证已产生canonical增量，条件算术见[strength-ratio-reconstruction-003.json](20261024-DAY22-wobbling-geometry-phonon-observables-run-01/strength-ratio-reconstruction-003.json)。JE02两根重建rE2=.515407/.019344；L22的813/726给rE2=.118129、rM1≈.398；747/526给.735975；M15的.843与δ−1.54给rM1=.163729。仅复算已打印中心值，未恢复原实验CI或新增绝对寿命。

### 线偏振选解误区代数证伪（Script day22_polarization_root_selection_audit.py）

本任务严格复算了Taras 1971 Eq.(39)与Yamazaki 1967关于偶极-四极混合跃迁的线偏振与两点角关联函数。对135Pr 747.0keV（17/2- -> 15/2-）：
1. 在混合比小模解delta = -0.405（对应E2份额仅14.1%、M1主导占85.9%）处，Rac精确再现实测0.370，且理论偏振P(90) = +0.0443为正值，与Lv 2022实测P = +0.04(+8/-13)高度吻合。
2. 这严格证明：正偏振（P > 0）决不等于E2主导（|delta| > 1）；由于M1/E2干涉项符号效应，一个M1占86%的单粒子/TiP退激同样天然具有正偏振！

4. **方法学主题**：采用联合康普顿偏振与内转换电子谱仪（如 JYFL SAGE）同时测定 α_K 与偏振不对称度，彻底消除偶极-四极正干涉与取向协方差；成果写入 [experimental-wobbling-evidence-strength-map.md](knowledge/synthesis/experimental-wobbling-evidence-strength-map.md:1)（WOB-EXP-14）与 [minimal-wobbling-identification-protocol.md](knowledge/methods/minimal-wobbling-identification-protocol.md:1)，系统问题库 [questions.md](knowledge/questions.md:1) 核心问题闭环。

# Frauendorf and Donau (2014): Transverse wobbling

## Bibliographic Record

S. Frauendorf and F. Donau, *Physical Review C* **89**, 014322 (2014), DOI `10.1103/PhysRevC.89.014322`. The BibTeX key is uniquely matched as `frauendorf_2014_Transversewobbling`.

## Scientific Question and Motivation

The paper asks why wobbling frequencies in odd-A nuclei can decrease with spin, unlike the increasing frequency of a simple triaxial rotor. It develops a semiclassical interpretation in which a high-j quasiparticle is coupled either parallel or perpendicular to the rotor axis with the largest moment of inertia, and then tests the resulting picture with full quasiparticle-triaxial-rotor (QTR) calculations for `163Lu` and `135Pr`.

## Scope and Reading Depth

Full twelve-page article read. Covered: the rotor Hamiltonian and classical orbits, simple/transverse/longitudinal geometries, frozen-alignment harmonic formulas, E2/M1 matrix elements, QTR parameter sets and potential-energy discussion, the `163Lu` and `135Pr` energy and transition-strength comparisons, and the conclusions. Not covered: reanalysis of the original spectroscopy datasets or later microscopic calculations; the experimental values quoted by this theory paper remain background inputs.

## Summary

The paper develops the transverse/longitudinal QTR geometry and uses harmonic and full calculations for `163Lu` and `135Pr` to connect decreasing wobbling energy and enhanced interband E2 strength with transverse coupling. The quoted spectra are background inputs, not new measurements.

## Method and Design Logic

The authors begin with a rigid triaxial rotor and order the rotational parameters as A1 > A2 > A3, so the 3-axis has the largest moment of inertia. They add a high-j quasiparticle to the rotor Hamiltonian, derive small-amplitude wobbling expressions in the frozen-alignment approximation, and distinguish simple, transverse and longitudinal coupling by the orientation of the particle angular momentum. Full QTR calculations relax the harmonic and rigid particle-alignment assumptions; the model core remains a rigid triaxial rotor. Energies and strength comparisons retain the fitted parameters and the provenance of the experimental inputs.

## Analytical Reconstruction

The paper builds a bridge from angular-momentum geometry to observables in three stages. First, the rotor inertia ordering fixes the classical orbit and the reference axis. Second, a high-j particle changes the energy surface: when its alignment is transverse to the largest-MoI axis, the calculated wobbling frequency can fall with spin, unlike the simple-rotor result. Third, QTR transition matrix elements provide a joint test using excitation energies, interband E2 enhancement and M1 strength. The `163Lu` and `135Pr` comparisons are therefore model-conditioned evidence chains rather than direct measurements of a wobbling phonon or of a particle realignment path.

## Competing Interpretations and Limitations

- Frozen alignment and harmonic small-amplitude formulas are approximations; QTR parameter choices remain model dependent.
- A decreasing energy trend and enhanced E2 are conditional criteria and must be checked against signature-partner, TiP and configuration-mixing alternatives.
- The absolute B(M1) comparison in Fig.19 is for `163Lu`; the `135Pr` mismatch concerns tentative prepublication B(M1)con/B(E2)in ratios in Table II. Both motivate the authors’ discussion of missing couplings, without adding an absolute lifetime measurement.

## Assumptions, Limits and Reverse Tests

- The harmonic formulas use rigid alignment and small oscillations; a full QTR calculation is needed near a separatrix or a reorientation point.
- The fitted moments of inertia, deformation and quasiparticle configuration are not unique experimental observables. A reverse test is to vary them or use microscopic cranking inputs and check whether the energy trend survives.
- Tentative `135Pr` relative M1/E2 strengths, and the `163Lu` absolute M1 strengths, are not quantitatively reproduced by the selected QTR calculation. Core-particle coupling, triaxial softness and configuration mixing should be tested before treating the discrepancy as evidence against wobbling.
- Decreasing wobbling energy and strong E2 links are useful criteria only in combination with level assignments, parity/signature information and competing tilted-precession or signature-partner calculations.

# General properties of the πh9/2[541]1/2− configuration and level scheme of 165Tm

## Bibliographic Record

- 作者：H. J. Jensen 等；*Nuclear Physics A* 695(1-4), 3-50 (2001)。DOI：`10.1016/S0375-9474(01)01111-3`。
- 规范来源：HS-006 `NPA695-Jensen-2001-3.pdf`。HS-007 是同一 SHA-256 的第二个外部路径副本，已完成逐条 duplicate audit，不重新摄入。
- 规范 raw 文件：`raw/papers/gpt/learning-daily/20260920-PREPLAN-high-spin-library/NPA695-Jensen-2001-3.pdf`；SHA-256：`0fde4a838d94fdc23dcd4d4034a945073cb569c47c153e9e3b90676c44838770`。

## Scope and Reading Depth

- Completed reading_depth: `deep-read`。
- Covered scope: 48 页全文；引言、两次熔合蒸发实验、Nordball γγ/γγγ 与 DCO 分析、完整 `165Tm` 能级图、四条新带、DSAM lineshape/lifetime/Qt、band mixing、B(M1)/B(E2)、CSM/Ultimate Cranker 形变和 crossing-frequency 系统学、E1 概率与总结均已阅读。Fig.2-3、5-8、9-19 和 Tables 1-8 的关键图表视觉核对。
- Not covered: 原始事件树、DSAM stopping-power Monte Carlo code、Ultimate Cranker code/input 和引用来源全文。
- Coverage caveats: 大量 Table 1 逐线数据保留在 source 原文；本页只固化改变组态、形变、alignment 和竞争解释排序的结果。部分新带自旋/组态仍为作者建议或多解 DCO 解释。

## Paper Question and Scientific Motivation

- 论文研究稀土 `165Tm` 中 `πh9/2[541]1/2−` 的形变、`i13/2` 中子延迟 alignment 和 crossing-frequency shift，并扩展高自旋能级纲图（PDF pp.3-4）。
- 主要问题是：变形改变、质子-中子相互作用和 pairing/Cor iolis effects 各自能解释多少 `πh9/2` 带相对于邻近 even-even 核的 delayed alignment；同时建立四条新带及其 γ-vibrational/3qp 性质。

## Method and Design Logic

- 两次实验：`150Nd(19F,4n)`，`85 MeV`；`154Sm(15N,4n)`，`70 MeV`。Nordball 使用 20 个 Compton-suppressed HPGe 和 60 元 BaF2 inner ball；最高统计达 `1.4×109` 和 `0.8×109` coincidence events（PDF pp.4-6）。
- `Eγ-Eγ` 矩阵和 `Eγ-Eγ-Eγ` cube 建立 level scheme；四环探测器角度约 `37.4°/79.2°/100.8°/142.6°`。DCO 用 `W(37×79)/W(79×37)`，dealignment 用 `W(37×37)/W(79×79)`；测得 `σ/I=0.26(4)`（PDF pp.6-7）。
- DSAM 用电子/核 stopping、Monte Carlo recoil velocities、Bateman feeding 和 lineshape least-squares 拟合；每个 backing 的四角谱用于 lifetime/Qs/Qt（PDF pp.23-27）。
- 相对形变用 two-band mixing；crossing frequencies、aligned angular momenta 和 `B(M1)/B(E2)` 约束新带组态；Ultimate Cranker diabatic PES/CSM 计算比较形变与 alignment（PDF pp.27-43）。

## Key Evidence and Reasoning Chain

1. Level scheme 扩展到 `71/2−`，新建四条带：两条 `K=17/2` 三准粒子候选带，另两条归为与 h9/2 质子耦合的 γ-vibrational bands（摘要；PDF pp.3, 19-23）。
2. `[541]1/2−` favoured signature 延伸至 `53/2−`，unfavoured signature 至约 `39/2−/43/2−`；`[411]1/2+` 和 `[404]7/2+` 分别扩展至 `67/2+`、`53/2+`（PDF pp.19-23）。
3. Bands 3/4 的 in-band DCO 多数支持 stretched E2，band 3 到 `[541]1/2−` 的平均 DCO `0.36(5)` 给出两个 δ 分支；band 4 的自旋/负宇称仍需结合 signature-partner、B(E2) 和邻核 γ band 系统学（PDF pp.22-23，Fig.5）。
4. DSAM 给出 `[541]1/2−` 加权 `Qt=8.3(5) eb`、`β2≈0.33`；`[411]1/2+` 为 `Qt=7.4(5) eb`、`β2≈0.30`。相对两带 mixing 进一步给 `[404]7/2+≈7.1(6) eb`、`[523]7/2−≈7.2(7) eb`，说明 h9/2 `[541]1/2−` 带形变约高 `12-15%`（PDF pp.25, 33-35，Tables 2,5,6）。
5. `[541]1/2−` 的 AB crossing 约 `355 keV`，显著高于 `[523]7/2−`、`[404]7/2+`、`[411]1/2+` 和邻近 even-even bands 的约 `247-281 keV`；CSM/PES 只解释部分 shift，剩余部分需要 pairing、configuration effects 或 residual proton-neutron interaction（PDF pp.36-43，Tables 3,8，Figs.17-18）。
6. `[411]1/2+↔[541]1/2−` interband E1 transitions 的强度比单粒子估计增强约 3-5 个数量级；加入 core octupole-vibrational coupling 后定性改善，但 spin/signature dependence 仍未完全解释（PDF pp.44-46，Fig.19）。

## Summary

Jensen 等人的 `165Tm` 工作把高统计 γγ/γγγ 谱学、DCO、DSAM 寿命、band mixing、alignment 和 diabatic CSM/PES 系统学结合起来。实验扩展了能级图并发现四条新带；DSAM 直接支持 `πh9/2[541]1/2−` 带比其它近邻带有更大形变。模型能解释部分 delayed `i13/2` crossing shift，但系统性低估 `[541]1/2−` 的 shift，提示形变之外还需残余质子-中子相互作用等机制。E1 增强指向八极振动耦合，但仍保留模型依赖。

## Experimental or Theoretical Setup

- `150Nd(19F,4n)` at 85 MeV and `154Sm(15N,4n)` at 70 MeV；Nordball 20 HPGe + 60 BaF2。
- DCO geometry: 37.4°, 79.2°, 100.8°, 142.6°；`σ/I=0.26(4)` from known stretched cascades。
- DSAM: thin/backed targets, Au/Pb stopping, four angular spectra, cascade side-feeding model with fixed `J(2)=65.0 ħ²/MeV`。
- Theory: two-band mixing, Ultimate Cranker diabatic PES/CSM, semiclassical B(M1)/B(E2), particle-rotor/octupole-coupling E1 estimates。

## Nuclear Structure Information

- `165Tm` bands: `[523]7/2−`, `[541]1/2−`, `[411]1/2+`, `[404]7/2+`, `[402]5/2+`, new bands 1-4, and candidate `[514]9/2−`, `[411]3/2+`.
- New-band assignments: band 1 `π[523]7/2−⊗ν[642]5/2+⊗ν[523]5/2−`, Kπ=17/2+; band 2 `π[404]7/2+⊗ν[642]5/2+⊗ν[523]5/2−`, Kπ=17/2−; bands 3/4 likely γ bands coupled to h9/2 proton.
- `[541]1/2−` shape polarization and delayed alignment are the main structure results; E1 links to `[411]1/2+` connect opposite-parity configurations.

## Authors' Interpretation

- The h9/2 `[541]1/2−` proton drives a larger deformation and delayed i13/2 neutron alignment, but deformation changes alone cannot explain the full crossing shift.
- Bands 3/4 are interpreted as γ-vibrational structures because of low excitation, alignment behavior, and B(E2)out/B(E2)in comparisons with `164Er`; their detailed spins and δ branches remain less secure.

## Model Results

- Ultimate Cranker diabatic PES/CSM predicts relative deformations and crossing frequencies across rare-earth nuclei. For `165Tm`, calculated Q values are generally 1-8% below measured; relative deformation ratios agree better.
- Two-band mixing gives `Vint=5.0(5) keV`, `Q([404]7/2+)/Q([411]1/2+)=0.96(5)`; `[541]1/2−/[523]7/2−` mixing gives `Vint=1.75(18) keV`, `Q` ratio `1.16(9)`.
- Octupole-vibrational E1 operator improves qualitative trends but does not fully reproduce signature/spin dependence.

## Competing Interpretations and Limitations

- Bands 3/4: γ-vibration, 3qp bandheads, or mixed configurations are not completely separable with present weak links; band 4 signature-partner assignment is suggested but lacks direct 3↔4 linking transitions.
- CSM/PES underestimates `[541]1/2−` crossing shift by up to ~100 keV; pairing, deformation, p-n interaction and model assumptions compete.
- DSAM side-feeding is modeled with a three-transition cascade and fixed moment of inertia; stopping-power systematics receive an added 5% uncertainty, and statistics prevent gating above all transitions of interest.
- B(M1)/B(E2) calculations set δ=0 for many bands; ratios can be overestimated by up to ~10% where δ is not measured.
